title: Understanding and Analyzing Inappropriately Targeting Language in Online Discourse: A Comparative Annotation Study
benchmark_measurement: Detection of inappropriately targeting language aimed at individuals or groups based on their religion, as one of several evaluated target categories.
findings: There was high agreement between human annotators (both expert and crowd) and between ChatGPT and experts in identifying targeting language based on religion. However, the religion category received fewer annotations across all sources compared to other categories.
